title: Behaviour Is an Incomplete Measure of Reasoning Development: Cross-surface pre-arrival accessibility and the limits of developmental inference in a recurrent-depth reasoner
abstract: arXiv:2608.16085v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Capability development is routinely inferred from behavioural thresholds, from final checkpoints, or from what a decoder can read out of a hidden state. These quantities need not identify the same event. We study a 30M-parameter recurrent-depth relational reasoner in a closed, oracle-defined world, using dense behavioural trajectories, two training surfaces, preregistered pre-arrival hidden-state probes, prospectively checked evaluability, and explicit untrained and negative controls, holding the training-time and inference-time axes separate throughout. Behaviour first: under one frozen acquisition criterion, three-hop competence cost 70 logical epochs on the symbolic surface and 13,055 on the verbal surface, a 186.5-fold contrast, after which verbal four-hop competence cleared in 8 logical epochs. Across the 13,055-epoch grind, four-hop held-out behaviour never exceeded 3/40 and ended at 0/40. Internal measurement next: on the verbal

translated_title: 行为是对推理能力发展的不完整度量：跨表面到达前可及性与循环深度推理器发展推断的局限性
translated_abstract: 摘要：能力发展通常从行为阈值、最终检查点或解码器能从隐藏状态读取的内容中推断出来。这些量不一定指向同一事件。我们在一个封闭的、由预言机定义的世界中研究了一个3000万参数的循环深度关系推理器，使用密集的行为轨迹、两个训练表面、预注册的到达前隐藏状态探针、前瞻性检查的可评估性，以及明确的未训练和负控制，在整个过程中保持训练时间和推理时间轴分离。行为首先：在一个固定的冻结获取标准下，三跳能力在符号表面上花费了70个逻辑纪元，在语言表面上花费了13,055个逻辑纪元，相差186.5倍，之后语言四跳能力在8个逻辑纪元内通过。在13,055个纪元的漫长过程中，四跳保留行为从未超过3/40，最终以0/40结束。内部测量其次：在语言表面上...
tldr: 该论文通过严格控制的实验表明，仅依靠行为指标（如训练阈值或解码器读出）无法可靠地推断推理能力的发展，因为不同训练表面上的行为表现差异巨大（186.5倍），而内部隐藏状态探针揭示了行为无法捕捉的能力变化，从而挑战了基于行为的发展推断方法。
en_tdlr: This paper demonstrates through rigorously controlled experiments that behavioral metrics alone (e.g., training thresholds or decoder readouts) cannot reliably infer reasoning capability development, as behavioral performance varied dramatically (186.5-fold) across training surfaces while internal hidden-state probes revealed capability changes invisible to behavior, challenging behavior-based developmental inference.
